extract_batch over URI inputs

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind, extractBatch } from "@xberg-io/xberg";
async function main() {
  const result = await extractBatch([{ kind: ExtractInputKind.Uri, uri: "pdf/fake_memo.pdf" } as ExtractInput, { kind: ExtractInputKind.Uri, uri: "text/fake_text.txt" } as ExtractInput]);
  for (const item of result.results ?? []) {
    console.log(item.content);
  }
}

void main();
```
